summary: Iteration 83: Verified NEW rake system (2.5% platform fee on profitable trades). All 21 backend tests passed. Rake correctly applies ONLY to profit portion, not original investment. Rake stats endpoint returns accurate totals. Fee entries in ledger have correct metadata (rake_percent, gross_pnl_sol). Frontend loads without errors.
passed_tests: 5. POST /api/ai-trader/manual-close-position with PROFIT returns rake object with applied=true, amount_sol>0, percent=2.5
6. POST /api/ai-trader/manual-close-position with LOSS returns rake object with applied=false, amount_sol=0
7. Rake calculation: 2.5% of profit ONLY (verified: 0.01 SOL profit → 0.00025 SOL rake)
8. GET /api/ledger/rake-stats/{wallet} returns total_rake_sol, total_gross_profit_sol, rake_count, rake_percent
10. Fee entries have metadata.rake_percent=2.5 and metadata.gross_pnl_sol
16. Rake calculation accuracy test: 0.1 SOL investment, 50% profit → 0.00125 SOL rake
20. Frontend AI Trader page loads without errors

rake_on_profit.behavior: Returns rake object with applied=true, amount_sol>0 when pnl_sol>0

no_rake_on_loss.behavior: Returns rake object with applied=false, amount_sol=0 when pnl_sol<=0
